# An update landing after unmount() marks the root's children mounted

## Context

The `#19928` arm in `test/playwright/e2e/grid/IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs` ("the filter list draws its focus ring inside the row and its rows on the menu surface, in both themes") flakes in `e2e-engine (3/4)`. After its second pick ("Duplicate", after Escape and a theme switch), `.neo-navigator-active-item` is never found. It failed twice on `#19964` (jobs 119302106742 and 119305785537) and earlier on `#19958` and `#19960`. `#19962` fixed one cause, a late search focus. At its head (`9fc08da9a9`), the arm still failed 5 of 24 runs locally under 8 workers.

Measured with a probe spec that replays the arm's exact sequence (local headless Chromium, `playwright.config.e2e.mjs`, same head):

- In every failing run, the reopened menu's value list never calls `Neo.main.addon.Navigator.subscribe`. In every passing run it does, about 1 ms after the menu mounts.
- A worker-side hook on `Neo.list.ValuePicker#afterSetMounted` records each transition with its stack. Passing: mount (first open), unmount (`Escape`: `hide()` → `unmount()` → container cascade), mount (reopen, via `initVnode`). Failing: mount, unmount, then **mount via `syncVnodeTree < executeVdomUpdate`**, an update flight landing ~1 ms after the unmount. The reopen finds the list already `mounted: true`, so `afterSetMounted` never fires and the new DOM is never subscribed.
- At the failure, the App worker reports the list `mounted: true, hasNavigator: true` and its element is in the DOM, without the Navigator's listeners.
- The flight is the surface's own. The first pick shows the Clear button (`refreshOptions` → `clear.hidden = false` → `surface.update()`), and `Escape` lands while that flight is out. The arm's `soft.poll(read)` between the first pick and `Escape` (14–46 ms) puts `Escape` inside the window: replicas without that poll passed all 98 runs, and with it 4–5 of 24 failed, in each of three runs.
- Holding the list's subscribe on the main thread until after the click reproduces the symptom 10/10.

## The Problem

`Component#hide()` on a component rooted at `document.body` calls `unmount()`, which sets `mounted = false` synchronously, and `Container#afterSetMounted` cascades that to the items: the value list unsubscribes from the Navigator. An update flight that left before the unmount still lands. `executeVdomUpdate` hands its vnode to `syncVnodeTree`, which sets `mounted = true` on every child component the vnode carries, without asking whether the root's DOM still exists. The children end up `mounted: true` under an unmounted root. When the root mounts again, the container cascade finds nothing to change, so no child's `afterSetMounted(true)` runs. The list never re-subscribes, and any other mount-time setup in those children is skipped too.

In the grid, a header menu closed inside that window and then reopened has no keyboard navigation and no focus ring in its value list, until the next close and reopen. The same code path applies to any `document.body`-rooted component hidden while one of its updates is in flight. That is inferred from the code; only the header menu is measured.

## The Architectural Reality

- `src/component/Base.mjs`: `hide()` → `unmount()` sets `vdom.removeDom = true`, `mounted = false` and sends a `removeNode` delta.
- `src/container/Base.mjs`: `afterSetMounted()` cascades `mounted` to items without `removeDom`.
- `src/mixin/VdomLifecycle.mjs`: the `executeVdomUpdate()` landing calls `component.syncVnodeTree(vnode, deltas)` for each root, and guards only destroyed roots (the `#19830` precedent). `syncVnodeTree()` sets `component.mounted = true` for each child found in the vnode.
- `updateVdom()` already refuses to start a flight on an unmounted root (it waits for `mountedPromise`). The only flight that can land on an unmounted root is one that left before `unmount()`.
- `src/list/Base.mjs`: `afterSetMounted()` subscribes to `Neo.main.addon.Navigator` on `true` and unsubscribes on `false`.
- **Design authority:** `Component#show()`'s JSDoc says "A component rooted at `document.body` mounts in one flight at a time, which lands on the latest `hidden`". `hide()` says "A node still in its mount flight does not exist yet: the flight unmounts it when it lands". A mount flight already honours a `hide()` that arrives while it flies. An update flight does not.

## The Fix

`syncVnodeTree()` marks the children it finds as mounted only while the root's DOM is live: `me.mounted || !me.vdom.removeDom`. A flight that lands after `unmount()` still adopts its vnodes but mounts nothing. The root's next mount does that, so every child's `afterSetMounted(true)` runs again. First renders are unaffected, because `show()` deletes `removeDom` before `initVnode(true)`, and `domWithheld` (toolbar overflow only) never renders a `document.body` root.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: An update flight that lands after its root's `unmount()` leaves the root's child components `mounted: false`, and the root's next mount runs each child's `afterSetMounted(true)`.
- [ ] AC-2: A grid header menu closed while its surface update is in flight, then reopened, marks the picked value with `.neo-navigator-active-item`.
- [ ] AC-3: Both are deterministic, red on base and green at head: a unit test for AC-1 and a browser e2e for AC-2.
- [ ] AC-4: Under the measured load (8 workers, 24 runs), the `#19928` arm fails on base and passes every run at head. This is an outside-CI receipt.

## Out of Scope

- The other flakes seen on `#19964`: `HeaderMenuShape.spec.mjs:133` (now `#19965`), `PremeasureRows.spec.mjs:76` and `SpawnAnimation.spec.mjs:183`.
- Whether a non-container root's `unmount()` should also unmount child components embedded in its vdom.
